content: St Mirren, competing in the Scottish Premiership, played to a goalless draw against League 1 champions Arbroath away from home and forfeited the bonus point after being defeated in the penalty shootout of the Premier Sports Cup.
St Mirren, who finished sixth in the top flight, at home to Ayr United, who lost in the promotion play-offs, is another potential top-place showdown on 27 July.
